focus_areas: Link continuity and closure (no broken or fused rings)
Interlocking geometry (links passing through each other correctly)
Texture realism (rust, metal grain, and wear patterns)
Boundary sharpness between chain and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interlocking points of the chain links. AI generators often struggle with the precise topology of one ring passing through another, sometimes resulting in fused metal or impossible geometries. Verify that the rust textures are consistent and not just noise overlay. Check if the shadows cast by the chain onto the blue surface are physically accurate.
image_description: A close-up view of a heavy, weathered metal chain attached to a blue painted surface and a rusty vertical post. The chain consists of thick, oval-shaped links with visible signs of oxidation and wear. The background features a textured blue surface with chipped paint and rust spots.

expert_testimonies.reason: To ensure the chain sits correctly in front of the blue surface and rusty post, checking for any depth bleeding or spatial inconsistencies.
To confirm the object is correctly classified as a chain and distinguish it from similar rope or cable structures.
To verify that each link is a closed, continuous loop without AI-generated breaks or fusions, and to check for clean boundaries against the background.
To assess overall image quality, texture consistency of the rust/metal, and detect any subtle generative artifacts like smearing or unnatural noise patterns.
